Bulletproof the system as a package rather than chasing one part: refresh the basics first (verify the thermostat opens, correct belt tension, healthy water pump, full flush) then fit an aluminum cross-flow/high-capacity radiator (Wizard Cooling, US Radiator) sized for the TR6, and add a thermostatically-switched electric cooling fan (e.g. Hayden/Spal ~14 in) which the community reports drops idle temps roughly 6–10°F and removes the parasitic drag of the engine fan.
